name: Supervisor Alert
Notification Test
script:
# Server Script (e.g. on Document Event: After Insert / After Save)

notification = frappe.new_doc("Notification Log")
notification.for_user = "Administrator"   # recipient
notification.from_user = frappe.session.user        # who triggered it
notification.type = "Alert"                          # Alert / Mention / Assignment / Share / Energy Point
notification.document_type = doc.doctype
notification.document_name = doc.name
notification.subject = f"New {doc.doctype}: {doc.name} needs your attention"
notification.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
